Odd numbers are whole numbers that cannot be divided by 2 without a
remainder and have 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9 in their ones place value.

Even numbers are whole numbers divisible by 2 without remainders.
They have 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8 in their ones place value.

Brainstorm the meaning of prime and composite numbers.

A prime number is a number that has only two factors, 1 and itself.

Composite numbers are numbers that have more than two factors.

The numbers 0 and 1 are neither prime nor composite numbers.
Each composite number can be expressed as a product of two or more prime

numbers.

9, 11, 15, 23, 25, 81, 99, 153, 227, 389, 427, 809

2. A farmer is planting trees in rows. Given that he has 17 trees, determine if he
can arrange them in more than one row with equal number of trees in each
row.

3. A teacher wants to organise learners into groups with equal number of
learners for a class activity. Given that there are 24 learners in total,
determine whether she can divide them in more than one way.

4. Ashopkeeper wants to arrange 29 oranges in neat rows on a display shelf.
Determine whether he can arrange them in multiple rows with equal number
of oranges.

5. At a birthday party, the host is giving away 36 cupcakes. The cupcakes
must be arranged in equal groups before distribution. Determine whether
the cupcakes can be grouped in different ways.

6. A charity organisation bought 348 bags of rice. They want to organise the
bags into groups with equal bags and share with different families in a village.
Determine whether the bags of rice can be arranged into more than 1 way.

7. A librarian is stacking books in columns. She has 21 books and wants to
arrange them evenly in different ways. Determine if this can be done.

8. Abaker is packaging 19 muffins into boxes. Determine if he can put them into
different boxes containing more than 1 muffin.
